patterns.note: Asymmetrical vertical split-screen layout for the hero section, creating a strong visual division between large text and a solid color block.
Exclusive use of a high-contrast primary palette of pure black, white, and vibrant red across all elements.
Dominant, oversized sans-serif typography used for branding and key headings, creating a bold and direct communication style.
A persistent, sticky header containing the logo and main navigation remains visible at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling.
Dedicated full-width video sections are used to showcase work or set a mood, playing automatically.
Grid-based project gallery with varying aspect ratios for images on interior pages, maintaining a clean and structured presentation.

technique_notes: A sticky header with a small brand mark and navigation is fixed at the top, providing constant access. Content sections scroll into view without complex transitions, though a prominent video hero section plays automatically to introduce a project or theme.

The design leverages a stark, high-contrast color scheme of black, white, and red. The hero employs an asymmetrical split-screen layout with large, bold typography on one side and a solid color block with a geometric shape on the other. Subsequent sections maintain a clean, minimalist aesthetic with generous whitespace.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels for navigation and sub-headings.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in hero and main content sections, with a tighter grid for project displays.

standout: The extreme high-contrast color palette (black, white, red) combined with oversized, bold typography and a dynamic, asymmetrical hero creates a very strong, memorable visual identity that feels more like a brand statement than a typical marketing site. The starkness and directness are highly distinctive.
